blocks.text: The specification has been approved on your side for a fortnight now and the first approaches are out, so I am starting this thread to keep the running record of the search in one place; I will send the substantive updates here and keep Nicole copied, since she holds the research and the calendar between us.

Where it stands this morning: the map runs to thirty-one businesses, we have approached nineteen people off it, and eleven of those are in live conversation. Four of the eleven are worth your attention already. I am describing them to you by the operation they run rather than by name until each of them has spoken to their own family and is ready for this to be real, which is the discipline we agreed and the reason people take our calls at all.

Two things from your side would help the pace. Nicole is looking for ninety minutes in your diary in the next fortnight for a calibration session, where we take you through the map and test the specification against what the market has actually said back to us; and three of the businesses on the target list sell into the same accounts as {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}}, so I need your ruling on whether they are open to us or off limits before the second wave goes out.
If you can give me that ruling by the end of next week, the second wave goes out the week after.
